question: Is joint optimization of several employers' production rosters and childcare capacity/funding already present in academic or pilot precedent, and what constructive contribution could remain?

verdict.academic_precedent_status: Unresolved. These three targeted queries did not retrieve a primary academic formulation combining all requested elements. The results concentrated on provider-side scheduling products and pilots; this is a coverage limitation, not positive novelty evidence.
verdict.demonstrated_overlap: There are delivered or piloted systems combining childcare resource scheduling, demand/capacity management and financial/contract administration. Together with the earlier review's employer consortia and roster accommodations, this makes a broad new-arrangement claim weak.
verdict.surviving_claim: A particular independently verified integration can still be an earned construction: it encodes and produces a coherent finite agreement among declared worker choices, employer coverage, care intervals, qualified staffing, funding and bounded contingency resources.
verdict.distinction_from_novelty: Successful integration does not establish historical firstness, proprietary uniqueness, an unmet market or beyond-human capability. A system can construct a useful artifact using established methods and still tie a competent conventional executor exactly.
verdict.precondition_for_earned_construction: Fresh-case acceptance must check the entire declared purpose, independent conventional-control parity must be reported, and adversarial modifications must be rejected or explicitly bounded. An optimizer's status flag and the author's own examples are insufficient.
verdict.current_technical_status: Post-selection audit complete in results/INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json. V1 independently matched 48 cases but incorrectly accepted 8 of 26 corruptions and falsely rejected a large-integer case. Frozen V2 rejects those prior bad pairs, corrects the scaling failure, and passes 12 fresh cases (6 offers, 6 refusals) and 20 fresh corruptions. Conventional same-formulation control ties; historical novelty remains unresolved.
verdict.technical_status_at_original_review: Technical audit pending in results/INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json; this document does not assert that those preconditions have passed.

primary_sources.title: Childcare Operations Optimisation
primary_sources.source_character: Implementer's own delivered-project case study; client unnamed
primary_sources.supported_facts: Biarri describes a delivered suite combining qualified staffing and ratio-aware rostering, response to attendance/staff disruption, and optimized waitlist transitions and enrollment across childcare centers.
primary_sources.contribution_overlap: Joint care-demand/capacity and qualified workforce planning is already implemented.
primary_sources.not_established: The source does not demonstrate changing the production rosters of multiple independent employers of the parents. Commercial results are the implementer's claims, not independently verified effects.

primary_sources.title: Legion WFM Platform Supports KinderCare with Enhanced Workforce Scheduling
primary_sources.organization: Legion Technologies, with a named KinderCare representative
primary_sources.source_character: Provider's announcement of a named customer deployment
primary_sources.supported_facts: The April 2025 announcement describes scheduling that matches center needs with staff preferences and incorporates staffing-ratio compliance templates.
primary_sources.contribution_overlap: Preference-aware constrained scheduling in actual childcare operations is established product work.
primary_sources.not_established: Parents' external employer rosters, multi-employer financing and the proposed contingency agreement are not demonstrated. No supplier ROI claim is adopted.

primary_sources.title: Childcare Connect contract management and reporting module
primary_sources.source_character: Implementer's original pilot announcement naming public-agency partners
primary_sources.supported_facts: OneHSN describes a July 2024 pilot with DNSSAB, developed with DNSSAB and DPSSSAB, linking contract and budget management with enrollment, center capacity and staffing-related funding.
primary_sources.contribution_overlap: Joining childcare capacity and financial/contract administration is already a piloted integration.
primary_sources.not_established: This is not evidence of an optimization algorithm jointly choosing production rosters across parents' employers. Its outcomes are reported by the vendor.

primary_sources.title: Service Delivery Review of Carleton Place Child Care Services
primary_sources.organization: Town of Carleton Place; review commissioned from OneHSN
primary_sources.source_character: Original commissioned report published by the public client
primary_sources.supported_facts: The review considers childcare operations, staffing, governance and financial sustainability together. The retrieved recommendation excerpt includes cross-agency staffing and supply-staff optimization, registration and enrollment digitization.
primary_sources.contribution_overlap: Public childcare service design already treats staffing, demand and financial sustainability as interacting concerns.
primary_sources.not_established: Recommendations are not proof that all were deployed; parents' production employers are not the jointly optimized actors.
primary_sources.publication_date: January 5, 2022; verified on the PDF, rather than inferred from its 2024 upload directory

formulation_boundary.parent_employer_rosters: Work schedules of parents at independent production employers.
formulation_boundary.childcare_staff_rosters: Schedules of educators and care workers inside childcare operations.
formulation_boundary.why_boundary_matters: Most retrieved optimization results concern the latter. Treating them as the former would falsely establish an exact equivalent; treating their related integrated methods as absent would falsely inflate novelty.
formulation_boundary.no_absence_inference: Marketing pages and these limited queries cannot establish that conventional consultants, bespoke contracting or unindexed academic work have never made the fuller combination.

falsifiers: A primary paper or documented deployment jointly changes consenting parents' work schedules at several employers, preserves the employers' operational requirements and funds the resulting care capacity and contingencies.
A competent conventional coordinator can already commission the same complete arrangement through existing services and contracts at comparable all-in cost.
The implementation's apparent advantage arises from giving the conventional comparator fixed rosters or weaker coordination rights while allowing the proposed instrument to change them.
The program silently relaxes care coverage, consent, qualified staffing, funding scope or finite backup to obtain a feasible result.
The only difference is faster execution of an unchanged familiar scheduling formulation.

interpretation_of_conventional_parity.expected_if_same_formulation: Equal feasibility and optimum cost are appropriate evidence that the conventional control was treated competently.
interpretation_of_conventional_parity.what_parity_rules_out: An execution-superiority claim, exclusive model capability, or any inference that ordinary optimization could not produce the arrangement.
interpretation_of_conventional_parity.what_parity_does_not_rule_out: The value of explicitly constructing and checking the multi-actor specification and a usable finite commitment artifact.
interpretation_of_conventional_parity.evidence_needed_beyond_parity: Independent tests must show that the integrated artifact satisfies the original declared purpose and identify which additional permissions or commitments change the feasible set relative to a meaningful status quo. Actual organizational acceptance and economics remain separate.

limitations: No systematic academic database review, citation-chain search or full patent search was performed.
The requested exact academic or multi-employer pilot precedent was not resolved.
No unpublished supplier contracts or deployments were inspected.
Product descriptions are primary evidence of what implementers say they built, not independent acceptance or outcome validation.

technical_audit_followup.claim: Finite constructive integration supported on tested inputs; no beyond-human, historical-first or demonstrated-demand claim.
